routes.name: OTP Expired Twice
routes.story_lens: Small pressure turns both partners into a working two-person panic system.
routes.reader_mirror: Every couple has done unnecessary emergency behavior over a tiny app timer.
routes.emotional_obstacle: The timer makes a normal task feel urgent, and the first failure could become blame.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She reacts fast, dramatic, and fully invested in the 30-second countdown.
routes.zuv_active_role: He reads, misreads, resets, leans in, and participates rather than rescuing.
routes.proof_engine: 30-second timer, unclear digit, expired state, resend reset, submitted checkmark.
routes.emotional_reversal: Failure becomes teamwork, and panic becomes shared rhythm.
routes.distribution_reason: Highly taggable for partners who have turned OTPs, logins, and small app tasks into missions.

stage_scene_gate.action: A harmless 30-second OTP starts a tiny home mission.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu types fast while Zuv reads too calmly, then both freeze over one unclear digit.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Their eye-lines move between the two phones and each other, proving shared pressure.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Two phones move closer together; his finger tracks digits, her thumb freezes, then both hands reset side by side.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The expired screen creates a deadpan pause before the resend.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The first attempt fails, forcing them into closer teamwork.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The ordinary task becomes a funny relationship proof: two people panicking correctly.

routes.name: Pause-Frame Blackmail
routes.story_lens: Paused TV catches one terrible face and becomes a private joke.
routes.reader_mirror: Couples save bad screenshots and never let each other live them down.
routes.emotional_obstacle: The joke can become one-sided teasing if not mutual.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She spots the ridiculous pause first and tries to save it.
routes.zuv_active_role: He dives for the remote, then laughs with her.
routes.proof_engine: Paused TV face, phone camera, cushion block, photo already taken.
routes.distribution_reason: Funny and visual, but less tender than OTP.

routes.name: Reel Inbox Audit
routes.story_lens: She sends reels all day; he reacts to the wrong part and gets audited.
routes.reader_mirror: Many couples communicate through reels and reaction policing.
routes.emotional_obstacle: It can drift into phone-addiction if not anchored in affection.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She knows exactly which second mattered.
routes.proof_engine: 18 reels, wrong emoji, 'watch till end', corrected reaction.
routes.distribution_reason: Very current but more phone-native than scene-native.

routes.name: Family Video Call Tripod
routes.story_lens: A family call turns them into each other's tripod and background rescue team.
routes.reader_mirror: Every couple has scrambled to fit both faces into one call.
routes.emotional_obstacle: Risk of becoming only a phone-angle joke.
routes.aachu_specific_spark: She wants both of them to look presentable instantly.
routes.zuv_active_role: He balances the phone and rescues the frame.
routes.proof_engine: Dono dikho, bad angle, arm tripod, background rescue.
routes.emotional_reversal: Awkward public call becomes private teamwork.
routes.distribution_reason: Strong but less fresh than the OTP countdown.

routes.name: Voice Search Vs Hinglish
routes.story_lens: Smart TV misunderstands both of them until they overpronounce together.
routes.reader_mirror: Home tech fails become couple comedy.
routes.emotional_obstacle: The machine can become the lead character.
routes.zuv_active_role: He joins the overpronunciation instead of judging it.
routes.proof_engine: Remote mic, wrong search result, exaggerated pronunciation.
